Tool marks on the Flare homepage
================================

The homepage names the capture tools Flare has a ready-made setup for and shows
each one's own mark beside its name. The marks are copies from each project.
They are not covered by Flare's MIT license: each stays under the terms below.
The names and marks belong to their projects, and showing them does not mean
those projects endorse Flare.

The license texts are in the "licenses" folder next to this file.


sharex.png
  The ShareX logo, by the ShareX Team.
  Original: ShareX.HelpersLib/Resources/ShareX_Logo.png
    https://github.com/ShareX/ShareX/blob/d1efe0c7ac/ShareX.HelpersLib/Resources/ShareX_Logo.png
  License: GNU General Public License, version 3 (licenses/GPL-3.0.txt)
    https://github.com/ShareX/ShareX/blob/d1efe0c7ac/LICENSE.txt
  Changes: scaled from 256 px to 72 px.

itake.png
  iTake's app icon. The artwork is the "Neocat & Neofox snuggle" emote by
  Volpeon (https://volpeon.ink/emojis/), which iTake uses as its icon.
  Original: preview/AppIcon.png
    https://github.com/SerStars/iTake/blob/af7baeb52b/preview/AppIcon.png
  License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0
    https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
  Changes: scaled from 1024 px to 72 px. This copy is under the same license.

flameshot.svg
  The Flameshot logo, by the Flameshot authors.
  Original: data/img/app/flameshot.svg
    https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/blob/dcb1291a5c/data/img/app/flameshot.svg
  License: Free Art License 1.3 (licenses/Free-Art-License-1.3.txt)
    https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/blob/dcb1291a5c/data/img/app/flameshotLogoLicense.txt
  Changes: none.

spectacle.svg
  Spectacle's icon from the Breeze icon theme.
  Copyright (C) 2014 Uri Herrera and others.
  Original: icons/apps/48/ksnapshot.svg
    https://github.com/KDE/breeze-icons/blob/7c81d01ed6/icons/apps/48/ksnapshot.svg
  License: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 or later
    (licenses/LGPL-3.0.txt and licenses/GPL-3.0.txt; the theme's own notice is
    licenses/Breeze-icons-notice.txt)
    https://github.com/KDE/breeze-icons/blob/7c81d01ed6/COPYING-ICONS
  Changes: none.

ember.svg
  The Ember mark, by FlintSH, who also makes Flare.
  Original: Ember's launcher icon, app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml
    https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/blob/747cffe/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml
  License: MIT.
  Changes: redrawn as SVG from the Android drawable, with the same paths and
  colors.
